restartBody: Units and claims stay. Initiative, HP, temp HP, conditions, disabled state, HP history, round and escalation die reset.
clearBody: All {{n}} units are removed and every player claim is released.
removeBody: The unit leaves the turn order. Undo can bring it back.
revokeBody: The current link stops working and every claim is released. Players need the new link.
deleteCombatBody: The combat, its {{n}} units and the player link are deleted. This can’t be undone.
deletePresetBody: The preset leaves the Library. Units already added to combats stay.
deleteAccountBody: All combats, presets and player links are deleted. This can’t be undone.
